Alicia —

Thanks for the clear constraints. Redwood can support a 48-hour presigned upload window and we can require single-use presigns tied to a manifest. High-level plan:

1) Preflight (today): we validate the manifest fields and scope in SOC2_Scope.xlsx.
2) Provisioning (we): create single-use presigned S3 PUTs scoped to object key prefixes, TTL = 24h by default (we can extend to 48h on request).
3) Upload (you): files uploaded within window; we verify checksums on receipt.
4) Handoff (we): we return a signed receipt (SHA256 + timestamp + ingest job id) and push evidence IDs into your Whistic profile if you authorize the API linkage.

Questions/asks for ClearWave:
- Confirm whether you prefer push -> our presigns or a Whistic/Vendr pull. Pulls add a 1–2 business day scheduling overhead for their connectors.
- If push, include a manifest.csv with filename, sha256, size, and doc type.

I'll loop in Jonas for the presign orchestration and Marissa for Whistic/Vendr syncing.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Security Intake Lead | Redwood Inference

Quick technical notes from ops so we can avoid edge cases during the window:

- Single-use presign approach: we will mint presigns scoped to the manifest row id. Any mismatch between manifest SHA and uploaded object will reject ingest and the presign is revoked.
- TTL: default 24h but we can set 48h for this intake. If you need 48h we will require a secondary verification ping at T+24h to ensure uploads are progressing (helps us keep ephemeral access safer).
- Large files (>200MB): multipart upload required; we will provide curated instructions and multipart presign endpoints.
- Audit trail: our intake lambda will produce an ingest receipt (signed JWS) you can store as proof of possession.

Attached is a sample calendar invite for a narrow window (upload_window_calendar.ics) and a short checklist.

Action items for ClearWave:
- Reply with preferred upload date window (two options OK)
- Confirm manifest.csv will be provided in the root of uploads
- If you want us to write the Whistic record on ingest, grant the API token here: https://whistic.com/profile/clearwave-invite

I'll be on the intake run during the window and will escalate to Marissa if we need profile-side syncs (Vendr/Whistic mapping).

— Jonas
